title: Compilation Is Not Correctness: Scan-by-Scan Evaluation of LLM-Generated PLC Programs
title_zh: 编译通过不等于行为正确：对 LLM 生成的 PLC 程序进行逐扫描周期评估

paragraphs.en: 提出 CycleBench 基准逐扫描周期评估 LLM 生成的 PLC 程序，并推出 CycleGen 方法将执行通过率提升 8.68 个百分点。 Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) automate industrial processes through repeated scans, each reading inputs, executing control logic, and updating outputs. Engineers write this logic in Structured Text (ST), a high-level textual language defined in IEC 61131-3. Large language models (LLMs) can now generate ST from natural-language requirements, yet compilation success and checks on selected properties or sampled scans can leave behavioral errors undetected. We introduce CycleBench, a benchmark of 301 ST tasks with behavioral requirements, public interfaces, reference programs, and executable scenarios. Its runtime executes each generated program and its reference under aligned inputs, initialization, and logical time, comparing their outputs after every scan. Across eight LLMs and baseline generation methods, execution pass rate trails compilation pass rate by 11.92 percentage points; observed failures include output-update, arithmetic, and timing errors. On fixed traces of programs directly generated by five LLMs, checking outputs only at every fifth scan misses 21.66% of the 157 failures detected by per-scan comparison; across sampling phases, the missed-failure rate ranges from 12.10% to 28.03%. These misses stem from transient output discrepancies, whose detection depends on the sampling phase. Building on this evaluation, we propose CycleGen, which generates multiple candidate ST programs, repairs their compilation errors with bounded compiler feedback, and selects one using runtime self-tests generated in a separate model context. CycleGen improves the execution pass rate over direct generation by 8.68 percentage points. Component ablations distinguish repair and self-test selection; candidate-count analysis shows diminishing returns, with no execution-pass-rate improvement beyond five candidates in our experiments despite 38.8% higher token consumption at eight.
paragraphs.zh: 提出 CycleBench 基准逐扫描周期评估 LLM 生成的 PLC 程序，并推出 CycleGen 方法将执行通过率提升 8.68 个百分点。可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）通过重复扫描实现工业过程自动化，每次扫描读取输入、执行控制逻辑并更新输出。 工程师使用结构化文本（ST）编写这种控制逻辑，这是一种由 IEC 61131-3 定义的高级文本语言。 大语言模型（LLM）如今能够根据自然语言需求生成 ST 代码，然而仅依赖编译成功以及对选定属性或抽样扫描周期的检查，可能无法发现行为错误。 我们提出 CycleBench，一个包含 301 个 ST 任务的基准，每个任务都带有行为需求、公开接口、参考程序和可执行场景。 其运行时在对齐的输入、初始化和逻辑时间下执行每个生成的程序及其参考程序，并在每次扫描后比较它们的输出。 在八个 LLM 和基线生成方法的评估中，执行通过率比编译通过率低 11.92 个百分点；观察到的失败包括输出更新错误、算术错误和时序错误。 在五个 LLM 直接生成程序的固定轨迹上，仅每第五次扫描检查输出会漏掉逐扫描比较所检测到的 157 个失败中的 21.66%；在不同采样阶段下，漏检失败率介于 12.10% 到 28.03% 之间。 这些漏检源于瞬态的输出差异，其检测与否取决于采样阶段。 在此评估的基础上，我们提出 CycleGen，该方法生成多个候选 ST 程序，利用有界的编译器反馈修复其编译错误，并通过在独立模型上下文中生成的运行时自测来选出最终程序。 CycleGen 相比直接生成将执行通过率提升了 8.68 个百分点。 组件消融实验区分了修复与自测选择的贡献；候选数量分析显示收益递减，在我们的实验中候选数超过五个后执行通过率不再提升，而八个候选时的 token 消耗增加了 38.8%。
